RBA flags rental inflation as a key concern, raising prospect of prolonged restrictive policy
AUD 'shocker' looms amid rising bond yields and oil-driven import cost pressure
Austal jumps on $1.9b bid; Flagship ups copper stakes as red metal soars
Australia softens gas reservation rules, easing Asian supply fears but drawing political criticism
High-end property sees steepest price falls while affordable segment remains resilient; NSW faces massive stamp duty revenue hit
Bathla collapse ripples through private credit market, raising systemic risk concerns

Power giant seeks AI data centre tenants at coal plant sites, intersecting energy transition and tech demand

sectors.trend: Bearish. Iron ore trouble spreading (82) pressures BHP, RIO, FMG. However, copper strength (78) and gold exploration activity (37, 38) provide selective pockets of strength. Sinopec's 8.9% China oil demand decline (60) is a structural overhang.
sectors.implications: Diversified miners face margin compression; pure-play copper and gold explorers (Kuniko, Gateway WA) offer relative outperformance. FMG.AX and BHP.AX under pressure.

sectors.trend: Negative. Rising bond yields and oil-driven inflation fears pressure NAB, CBA, ANZ, WBC. RBA rental inflation concern (32) implies delayed rate cuts. Bathla private credit collapse (56) signals credit stress spillover risk.
sectors.implications: Net interest margin pressure from delayed cuts; credit cycle deterioration risk. CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX under pressure.

sectors.trend: Mixed. $100 Brent (9, 52, 62) supports Woodside, Santos, Origin short-term. But gas reservation softening (35, 49) and AI data centre power demand (76, 80, 81) create structural shifts. NSW power adequacy concerns (80) favour generators.
sectors.implications: WDS.AX, STO.AX benefit from oil spike; energy transition disrupted by data centre demand. Coal-to-data-centre pivot (76) is a thematic opportunity.

sectors.trend: Under pressure. Woolworths price freeze breach (31) and $100 oil-driven input costs squeeze margins. Cost-of-living sensitivity elevated.
sectors.implications: WES.AX, WOW.AX face margin headwinds; defensive positioning warranted but pricing power questioned.

sectors.trend: Divergent. High-end residential sees steepest falls (57); affordable segment resilient. NSW stamp duty revenue hit (50) signals policy risk. Rental inflation (32) supports REIT yields but caps affordability.
sectors.implications: Property developers (GPT.AX, CGP.AX) face demand softening at top end; REITs (ICP.AX, VMC.AX) benefit from rental inflation but face cap rate pressure.

sectors.trend: Selective. Austal $1.9b bid (75) is a positive M&A signal. AI data centre buildout (76, 81) drives power and infrastructure demand. Critical Resources battery tech validation (36) supports EV supply chain.
sectors.implications: AUS.AX (Austal) immediate catalyst; infrastructure and power names benefit from data centre capex cycle.

key_themes: $100 oil as macro pivot: import-cost inflation vs energy sector earnings
Iron ore structural weakness spreading through Chinese demand softness
RBA rental inflation dilemma delaying rate cut cycle
AUD depreciation risk from oil shock and yield divergence
Housing bifurcation: luxury correction vs affordable resilience
Private credit stress (Bathla) as early warning for broader credit cycle
AI data centres disrupting energy transition narrative
Gas reservation policy shift and Asian supply security

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Oil at $100+ triggering import-cost inflation and RBA policy delay
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge consumer and transport exposure; overweight energy (WDS.AX, STO.AX) as inflation hedge

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Iron ore demand deterioration from China (Sinopec 8.9% oil demand cut)
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX weightings; rotate into copper (78) and gold (37, 38)

risk_assessment.risk_factor: AUD sharp depreciation ('shocker') from oil shock and yield gap
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge AUD exposure; favour export-oriented miners and resources over import-dependent consumer names

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Private credit contagion from Bathla collapse
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor bank credit loss provisions; avoid leveraged credit exposures; favour large-cap banks with strong capital buffers

risk_assessment.risk_factor: NSW power adequacy and energy transition disruption from data centres
risk_assessment.mitigation: Overweight generators and grid infrastructure; monitor AEMO capacity warnings

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Housing market correction at high end; NSW stamp duty revenue shortfall
risk_assessment.mitigation: Avoid luxury property developers; favour affordable-segment REITs and construction names

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight energy producers as $100 oil provides earnings tailwind
opportunities.rationale: Brent above $100 since May; WDS and STO benefit directly; gas reservation softening supports export volumes

opportunities.recommendation: Rotate from iron ore to copper and gold on relative commodity strength
opportunities.rationale: Iron ore trouble spreading while copper soars and gold exploration active in WA/NSW

opportunities.recommendation: Position in Austal on $1.9b bid catalyst
opportunities.rationale: M&A premium event; shipbuilding sector benefits from global rearmament and LNG fleet demand

opportunities.recommendation: Long-term exposure to AI data centre power demand via generators and infrastructure
opportunities.rationale: Coal-to-data-centre pivot (76) and NSW power adequacy concerns (80) create structural capex cycle

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce diversified miner exposure; trim BHP, RIO, FMG
defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore structural weakness and Chinese demand decline (8.9%) create multi-quarter headwind

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge AUD and consumer inflation risk via energy and gold
defensive_moves.rationale: AUD shocker risk (51) and $100 oil import costs pressure consumer staples and importers

defensive_moves.recommendation: Avoid luxury property developers; favour affordable-segment REITs
defensive_moves.rationale: High-end correction steepest (57); NSW stamp duty hit (50) signals policy risk at top end

defensive_moves.recommendation: Monitor bank credit provisions post-Bathla; favour CBA for capital strength
defensive_moves.rationale: Private credit contagion risk (56); CBA best-capitalised large bank

market_outlook.short_term: ASX 200 likely to open lower on $100 oil, rising bond yields, and iron ore weakness. Miners and banks lead declines. Energy and gold provide relative strength. AUD under pressure. Expect 1-2% index downside in near term.
market_outlook.long_term: Structural shift underway: iron ore demand plateauing, copper/gold gaining, AI data centres reshaping energy demand. RBA constrained by rental inflation. Housing bifurcation persists. 6-12 month outlook cautiously neutral with sector rotation from traditional resources to copper, gold, and energy infrastructure.

Private credit / leveraged loan spreads post-Bathla
